tools.name: birth_chart
tools.description: Draw an accurate birth (natal) chart: Sun, Moon and rising sign, every planet with sign, degree and house, the angles and the tightest aspects. Works without a birth time (then no rising sign or houses). Returns a link to the person's sky in 3D on Pluto Garden and guide pages for each placement. Pas

tools.name: sky_now
tools.description: Today's sky (or any date from 1901 to 2100): the Moon's phase, sign and how much is lit, the next full moon (with its traditional name) and new moon, which planets are retrograde and until when (answers "is Mercury retrograde?"), and the sign of every planet.

tools.name: famous_chart
